text:
Sam: Hey team — heads up, my flight got rebooked. I can’t cover tonight’s primary from 20:00-02:00 UTC. Sorry for the late ping. Can someone pick up primary for that window? I can still be shadow until 21:00 if needed.

oncall-bot: @Sam noted — please confirm timezone. To reassign primary, run `oncall transfer --from sam --to <name> --start 2024-03-15T20:00Z --end 2024-03-16T02:00Z` or use the rota page: https://internal.redwood/rota/prim-sec

Nina: I can take primary 20:00-02:00 UTC. Happy to jump in. I’ll take pager and handle any customer-facing stuff. :thumbsup:

Sam: Amazing, thanks @Nina. Please grab the pager. Leaving some context: last 6h had a ~5% error bump on embeddings write path; not customer-visible yet but monitor.

Alex: Quick note — I’ll be on standby as secondary from 19:30-02:30 in case of escalation. I’ll enable verbose logs for the embeddings workers.

Nina: Got it. Can someone paste the runbook snippet for embeddings degradation? Don’t want to chase it blind.

oncall-bot: Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeds-degradation
incident-bot: ALERT 1748500012 — embeddings-write latency spike detected (>300ms p95 for 5m) — Severity: SEV-LOW — Pager not fired.

Nina: Saw the bot — pulling telemetry now. If needed, I’ll toggle the worker pool to 6x.

Alex: Before scaling, check cache-hit ratio. If prefix cache hit drops below 60% scaling won't help. Run:```bash
# quick metrics check
curl -s "https://infra-metrics/api/series?m=cache.hit_ratio&p=embeds" | jq .rate
```

Nina: Cache hit is at 72% right now. I’ll run a manual scale to 6 workers if we cross 65%.

Sam: Also FYI — there’s a canary config that rolls out at 21:00 that could affect this path (canary-id=canary/embeds-21). If it starts failing, rollback instructions are below.

Nina: Paste rollback?

Alex: Rollback steps (short):
1. Check canary status: `kubectl get deploy canary-embeds -n prod -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions}'`
2. If failing, run: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/embeds-service -n prod --to-revision=REV_BEFORE_CANARY`
3. Notify infra on #eng-infra and set alert owner to "oncall".

Nina: Copy. I’ll watch the canary at 21:00 and will notify here if I trigger rollback.

incident-bot: NOTE 1748500150 — automated rollback candidate flagged for canary/embeds-21: failure_rate > 1% in last 2m.

Nina: I’m rolling back canary now. Running `kubectl rollout undo deploy/embeds-service -n prod`. Will post when complete.

Alex: Thanks — once rollback is complete, confirm the perf graphs look healthy and I’ll drop back to normal logs.

Nina: Rollback finished at ~1748500230. Post-rollback p95 dropped back to 120ms. No customer impact seen. I’ll keep primary watch until 02:00.

Sam: Thanks @Nina, appreciate the cover. I’ve updated the rota and left notes under the shift.

Nina: All good. If anything escalates I’ll page the team. Otherwise I’ll post a short recap at 02:05. :white_check_mark:
